experiment_data.hypothesis: Random OCC (random labels, gradient flow enabled) should preserve encoder representations similar to Vanilla/Full OCC, confirming that gradient flow—not label content—prevents representational drift. If Random OCC CKA matches Detach OCC (low), then label content matters; if it matches Vanilla/Full OCC (high), gradient flow is the key factor.

metrics.key_finding: Random OCC CKA matches Vanilla/Full OCC (0.956-0.968), confirming gradient flow—not label content—preserves encoder representations. Only Detach OCC shows catastrophic drift.
